Hi there, and thank you for contacting Leafy! 🌿

**Yes, it looks like you'd get the full $59 back.** Leafy Plus is fully refundable if you cancel within **14 days** of purchase or renewal **and** haven't used any member benefits. Since your renewal was 5 days ago and you haven't ordered anything since, you're well within the window, with about 9 days left.

- **Benefits count as used if** you've had free Standard shipping, a free change-of-mind return, member pricing on pots or accessories, or a plant claim under the 90-day guarantee since renewing. If none of those apply, you're eligible.
- **Refund timing:** the refund goes back to your original payment method. Once issued, cards take **5-10 business days** and digital wallets take **3-5 business days**.
- **If you cancel after the 14 days,** there's no refund, though your benefits would continue to the end of the paid year.

I don't have the exact steps for cancelling Leafy Plus in my knowledge base, so I don't want to point you to the wrong place. To be safe, you can email **help@leafy.example** (answered within 1 business day) or use chat (8am-8pm Mon-Sat, your local time). Please do that well before the 14 days are up.

Is there anything else I can help with? We're always happy to hear from you. 😊
